code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/PS/{form/PSForm,form/PSDetails,form/PSSummary,list/PSList,page/PS,page/PSView}.tsx, pages/NoticeSearch/hook/{ApplyOperationAction.tsx,useBatchOperation.ts}, context/OptionsContext.tsx, utils/{mapping,validation}/PS/PS.ts, utils/constant.ts. ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core/SuspensionProcessingController (staff-apply-suspension, staff-revive-suspension, staff-check-suspension-eligibility), core/helpers/{PermanentSuspensionHelper,SuspensionBaseHelper,SuspensionProcessingHelper,PermanentRevivalHelper,RevivalBaseHelper}, crud/ocmsizdb/suspendednotice/SuspendedNotice, api-authorization.properties (OCMS_APPLY_PS). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not used by this staff PS flow
note: Status in stories.json is 'Fully paid'; there is no OCMS flow deck. Apply runs synchronously in one POST staff-apply-suspension request: the server updates VON and inserts a new suspended_notice record per notice, then the UI shows the result. Two gaps: an eVON (internet DB) sync failure is only logged while the UI still reports success; and the UI does not check the API error, so a failed request is shown as 'Applied Successfully to 0 Notices'. Maintenance tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-027 (duplicate sr_no, Closed; sr_no is now requested from the sequence per notice, SuspensionProcessingController.java:997) and OCMS-DF-2026-075 (Closed; re-applying PS on a paid notice, PermanentSuspensionHelper.java:82-95). Per-environment properties/DB values cannot be verified from the repo.
recommendation: Claim mostly: applying PS straight to VON and suspended_notice works; fix the result prompt that shows success when the request fails and the eVON sync failure that goes unreported

steps.step: After the officer presses OK, the UI immediately sends the apply PS request for all selected notices
steps.detail: onSubmit -> onAPI POSTs to staff-apply-suspension with noticeNo[], suspensionType PS, reasonOfSuspension, suspensionRemarks and officerAuthorisingSuspension = user.userId. The endpoint is only allowed for users with function OCMS_APPLY_PS (api-authorization.properties:61-63) through OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor registered for /** (WebConfig.java:76-82). The server uses the officer from the payload without matching it to the JWT user; not claimed.

steps.step: OCMS permanently suspends each notice right away under the specified code (VON updated, new suspension record written)
steps.detail: staffApplySuspension calls processNoticeList; for each notice the sr_no is requested from sequence SUSPENDED_NOTICE_SEQ inside the loop (SuspensionProcessingController.java:997, fix of OCMS-DF-2026-027) and then PermanentSuspensionHelper.processPS checks mandatory fields, that the code is allowed for source OCMS with status A (SuspensionBaseHelper.java:294-311), that the stage fits the code (SuspensionBaseHelper.java:189-279) and the paid-notice rules. If these pass, updateVON sets suspension_type=PS, epr_reason_of_suspension, epr_date_of_suspension and due_date_of_revival=NULL, and inserts an ocms_suspended_notice row (suspension_source OCMS, process_indicator Manual). All of this happens in the same request, without cron or queue. One notice failing does not cancel the others; results come back per notice. The list of PS codes that switch payment off (PS_DISABLE_PAYMENT) comes from the standard code table: its content cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: The notice copy in eVON (public portal) is updated too so the suspension takes effect on the public side immediately
steps.detail: updateDatabase calls updateEVON after updateVON. If the eVON record is not found, the sync is skipped (SuspensionBaseHelper.java:390-393); on an exception it is only logged and processing continues (SuspensionBaseHelper.java:431-434), so PS is reported 'PS Success' even if eVON did not change. eVON uses a different datasource than VON; no rollback or retry mechanism is visible in the repo. This step is inferred from the meaning of 'immediately' for notices that the public also pays; the story does not mention eVON explicitly.

steps.step: OCMS prompts the officer that the permanent suspension succeeded (or failed per notice)
steps.detail: The per-notice result is split into success/failed from res.result.data.results, successful notices are re-fetched, then the modal shows 'Permanent Suspension Applied Successfully to N Notices.' or 'x out of y Notices Failed to Applied Permanent Suspension...' and the /notices/ps/view page lists the results (PSForm.tsx:149-185, 203-258; PSView.tsx:72-100). Gap: onAPI does not check res.error. useAPI/CRUD puts failures (403, 500, network) in response.error with a null result (utils/api/index.ts:84-103, 199-213), so results = [] and failed.length = 0; onSubmit then shows a success modal (isError false) 'Applied Successfully to 0 Notices' (PSForm.tsx:213-219). The server also always replies appCode OCMS-2000 even when every notice failed (SuspensionProcessingController.java:1106-1115), so the UI can only rely on the per-notice results.
